en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3480 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a mukatab (a slave under a contract of emancipation) who dies after having paid part of his contract. He had a son from his bondwoman and left behind wealth.
Imam (as) said: "His son shall pay the remaining amount of the contract, be freed, and inherit what remains."
